usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It sieves primes up to 200000 once, then answers each query from precomputed tables of the prime count and largest prime for every `n`.

I ran Example 2 through `wj run --compiled main.wj`, and the output matched. I didn't run Example 1 or any larger inputs, so the upper end of the range is untested.
